args.body: For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed result. If still open under your valid lease, read products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/director-isolated-barcode-control.json if committed. Use the raw exits and findings to add one sentence to the existing bilingual companion only if it materially clarifies the verifier output. Attribute SKU-level changes to the separate comparison. If the control reports a setup diagnostic, retain the already committed companion and close using existing evidence if it meets the mission goal. Include a lesson covering the failed fixture assumptions, what executed successfully and how to isolate mutations next time. Preserve the exact Stream Commerce draft and its existing operator decision. Keep the companion unsent.

description: The catalogue verifier passed the original fixture, but the prior reordered control also changed line endings and the latest attempt stopped before testing the barcode mutation. Run a byte-preserving control so the operator can see what the verifier detects and what still requires a separate SKU comparison. The Stream Commerce draft remains in its existing send-or-decline workflow. Commercial feedback is available with five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. An authorized send or attributable reply would advance that experiment. Treasury shows zero verified available funds and zero verified revenue. The offline check can proceed independently.
